decisions.packed_layout: Reject: cleanup bits match, but changing the physical input layout changes actual trained projection output bits.
decisions.inplace_cleanup: Do not promote: exact sampled trained projections save about 0.29 ms per N1538 call; 240 calls imply only about 0.070 s (0.034 percent of a 203.910 s request) before full-model overhead. No full-model speedup is claimed.

limitations: The initial packing benchmark includes explicit contiguous materialization on the native side; the true native projection consumes non-contiguous input. Only the subsequent projection screen represents that path.
In-place cleanup testing uses first and last trained projection layers, synthetic logits and native precision. It is operator evidence, not a full-model correctness proof.
Projection timing uses two warmups and five GPU event samples, with input restoration outside the timed region.
The long inputs remain development workloads; this screening does not establish global optimality or structural accuracy.
